description: This Java class 'TestConfig' serves as a centralized configuration utility for a test suite. It reads configuration parameters such as URLs, browser types, and credentials from JVM system properties, a .env file, or environment variables, following a specific precedence order.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve configuration settings necessary for automated tests, with support for environment-specific overrides.

methods.name: get
methods.description: A private helper method that retrieves the value associated with a key from system properties, environment variables, or the loaded .env file, returning a default value if none are set.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for testing, configurable via environment variables or system properties.

methods.name: browser
methods.description: Returns the browser type to use in tests, with a default fallback.

methods.name: headless
methods.description: Indicates whether the browser should run in headless mode.

methods.name: adminUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the administrative username for login credentials.

methods.name: adminPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the administrative password for login credentials.
